resources.name: Turbomole or equivalent DFT code

access.notes: Turbomole is available for free academic download after registration. Open‑source alternatives (PySCF, ORCA, NWChem) that support B3LYP/VWN5 with the required ECP/basis (LACVP on Fe, 6‑31G on other atoms) are acceptable.

resources.notes: The DFT code must be able to perform geometry optimizations and single‑point energy calculations with the B3LYP/VWN5 functional using a small‑core ECP + double‑zeta basis on iron and 6‑31G on light atoms.
